mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oj_account (user_id, platform, handle, encrypted_credential, credential_iv, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{platform}, #{handle}, #{encryptedCredential}, #{credentialIv}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE oj_account SET handle = #{handle}, encrypted_credential = #{encryptedCredential}, credential_iv = #{credentialIv}, status = #{status}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, platform, handle, encrypted_credential, credential_iv, status, last_sync_at, created_time, updated_time FROM oj_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND platform = #{platform} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, platform, handle, encrypted_credential, credential_iv, status, last_sync_at, created_time, updated_time FROM oj_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY platform
SELECT id, user_id, platform, handle, encrypted_credential, credential_iv, status, last_sync_at, created_time, updated_time FROM oj_account WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
